releases.notes: ## Features: * Update to Minecraft version 1.18 experimental snapshot 2. * Add Crimson Fungus Artifact. * Add Rabbit foot Artifact. * Add Depth Mending Artifacts. * Add Guidebooks that can be found throughout the world with lore and mechanics. * Add */artifacts* command with various debugging/cheat tools. * Add ascension based effect mode with *doStrainsOnAscension* gamerule * Add Pica Spirit Boss with multiple stages and mechanics. * Optimize CPU times for almost everything. In general, things are much faster. * Add warning to clients trying to run the mod client-side. * Add localization for horror messages. * Add more horror messages. * Remove lore lines from artifacts for a more vanilla-like feel. * Add [github wiki](https://github.com/StoneLabs/strains-of-ascension/wiki) (this is not really a change to the mod but i'll just add it here anyway) ## Fixes: * Fix crash caused by brewing stand mixin. * Fix Wither talisman 3 having incorrect NBT data. * Fix crash caused by clients trying to run the mod client-side. * Fix doNauseaWithPoisonStrain gamerule. * Probably some other unknown bugs as the codebase was heavily refactored. ### Don't forget to set the following in server.properties: ```editor-config resource-pack=https\://github.com/StoneLabs/strains-of-ascension/releases/download/v2.7.0/strains_of_ascension_resourcepack.zip ``` ## *Download the server-only mod jar below.*

releases.notes:
| 🛑 **PLEASE NOTE:** All releases below are preview releases. They are not compatible with the full releases and updating from them will render artifacts unusable. Don't use them for anything but testing. |
| --- |



### Features:
* Update to MC 1.17 (still intended for 1.18+ usage)
* Add Artifacts that can be found in the world. These have special effects and capabilities. These inclued Prism of Sloth, Shield of *spoiler*, Wither Talisman, Poison Talisman and Strain Meter.
* Add resource pack needed for localization of Artifacts. It is recommended to install it as the server resource pack!
* Add new Goat sounds to insanity effect
* Remove `NVCancelSpeedMultiplier` gamerule for compatibility with new artifacts.

### Balancing:
* Large changes due to introduction of aformentioned artifacts.

### Fixes:
* Fix NV being milk safe in layer 5

### Don't forget to set the following in server.properties:
```editor-config
resource-pack=https\://github.com/StoneLabs/strains-of-ascension/releases/download/v2.6.0/strains_of_ascension_resourcepack.zip
```
## *Download the server-only mod jar below.*

releases.notes:
### Features:
* Lunar cycle will now effect layer boundary.
* Add new gamerule `lunarDifficultyLayerImpact` to control lunar cycle effect
* Add new gamerule `doDebugStrainHeight` to show players their current effect height
* Change formula for local Difficulty effect calculation. (see details below for more information)

### Balancing:
* `localDifficultyLayerImpact` default is now `3.0` for default max deviation of `-3.0 blocks`
* `lunarDifficultyLayerImpact` default is now `3.0` for default max deviation of `-3.0 to +3.0 blocks`
